meta.title: The Lantern Run
meta.story: Carry a little festival light through the wildlands to the old observatory. Follow the sun pegs, gather helpful crystals, and bring every neighbor a reason to look up.

chapters.title: The Lantern Run
chapters.story: Carry a little festival light through the wildlands to the old observatory. Follow the sun pegs, gather helpful crystals, and bring every neighbor a reason to look up.

finale.title: A Sky Shared by Everyone
finale.story: The observatory lantern shines over every path you crossed. Gardeners, ferry crews, mountain families, and lighthouse keepers gather below its warm glow. The festival begins with one small light, carried all the way by you.

levels.title: A Spark to Carry
levels.story: The festival lantern holds only a tiny spark. Light the garden markers to lift its glass cover, then take the first step toward the distant observatory.

levels.title: Dandelion Directions
levels.story: A ribbon of dandelions points across the meadow. Wake the sun markers along the path so the lantern can follow their gentle light without losing its way.

levels.title: Petal Bridge
levels.story: Petals hide the little bridge at the edge of the garden. Gather the bright glass pieces caught among them and fit a stronger window around your traveling flame.

levels.title: The Singing Grove
levels.story: Wind plays a tune through the bamboo. Follow its hanging markers and the grove will answer with a rhythm that keeps you company on the road.

levels.title: Moss Gate
levels.story: The forest gate has slept beneath a coat of moss. Build a bright chain of bounces to wake its patient keeper and open the trail between the trees.

levels.title: A Hood for the Mist
levels.story: Cool spray fills the waterfall steps. Light the sheltered markers to guide your lantern through the mist while a friendly burst clears the wet branches ahead.

levels.title: The River Ferryman
levels.story: The ferryman offers a crossing, but his guiding crystals have slipped loose. Gather enough shining pieces to mark the safe channel for your boat and everyone behind it.

levels.title: Lantern on the Lake
levels.story: The lake is still enough to reflect a second lantern beneath your boat. Follow the sun pegs across the water and keep both lights traveling together.

levels.title: Copper Leaves
levels.story: Autumn leaves collect in a warm copper trail. Let your bounces rustle through them until their glow reveals the old signpost toward the mountains.

levels.title: The High Meadow
levels.story: The path climbs into a meadow above the trees. Its scattered sun markers lead toward a sheltered pass, and the broad base plate gives every careful shot another chance.

levels.title: Snow Shelter
levels.story: A soft snowfall dims the next stretch of trail. Light the markers one by one to find a little stone shelter and keep the festival flame warm inside.

levels.title: Northern Ribbon
levels.story: A ribbon of northern light reaches down to the pass. Collect its icy crystals to make a lens that can carry the lantern beam far beyond the mountains.

levels.title: Warm Sand Road
levels.story: Beyond the pass, morning warms a quiet road of golden sand. Follow the sun markers between the dunes; your lantern is bright enough to guide travelers even here.

levels.title: Echo Steps
levels.story: Your footsteps return as friendly echoes from the canyon walls. Build a ringing chain of bounces and the echoes will reveal the stairway down to the harbor.

levels.title: A Harbor Welcome
levels.story: The harbor families have heard that a festival light is coming. Wake their dock markers, and a small boat will carry you to the lighthouse at the headland.

levels.title: The Lighthouse Lens
levels.story: The lighthouse keeper lends you the final parts of a great lens. Gather its clear crystals and focus the festival light toward the observatory on the hill.

levels.title: Homeward Shore
levels.story: Lights now answer from cottages along the shore. Follow their sun pegs up the coastal path as neighbors begin walking toward the celebration behind you.

levels.title: The Moon Dial
levels.story: Inside the observatory, a moonlit dial waits for its missing signals. Light every sun marker to turn the silver dial and uncover the path through the star chamber.

levels.title: The Star Bell
levels.story: The star chamber hums around your little lantern. Build a final bright score to ring its great bell and tell the whole valley that the festival is ready.

levels.title: Raise the Festival Light
levels.story: Friends from every part of the journey are waiting below the observatory. Light the last markers, lift the lantern into its place, and let the night belong to everyone.
